## New work in this package

The new contribution is the exact puncture of eight isolated coordinate-port
summands, the explicit retained-port transport and global data restriction,
a newly discovered full whole-owner allocation for the smaller family stock,
the independently written raw restriction/chart/window/owner audit, and the
complete new finite invoice and exact global kappa assembly. The proof and
reproduction runner combine those ingredients without adding nominal gains.

## Comparisons and exclusions

PR518 is a newer numerical comparison; none of its additional pair choices,
99-pivot word or owner transport is copied. PR510's higher bit rate is also
not used. PR517's smaller asynchronous witness and packing ceiling are public
context, not dependencies. PR520's open allocator and delivery map were seen
only in the final comparison refresh; its code was not adopted. PR516 and PR519 are formalization context, not new
Lean certifications claimed here. The disputed split-residual interfaces of
PR494/499 are not used. Failed cyclic-packet and E7 experiments contribute no
numerical saving.

Credits identify ingredients and provenance, not independent additive gains
or a claim that every inherited interface has been freshly verified.
